newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch closing debt market report.
newsitem.headline: Dutch closing debt market report.

text.p: Dutch bonds closed higher, lifted by firmer Bunds in a steady but quiet session among positive sentiment.
Weaker-than-expected German September wholesale prices data got the market moving up in the morning, traders said, while U.S. treasuries came in firm in the afternoon.
"We have pretty good sentiment at the moment, well bid and not many offers," one said.
Interest will now focus on U.S. September CPI data due on Wednesday, dealers said, with many players expecting to see the frontmonth Bund future targeting par if the data is supportive.
With the market slightly uncertain, gains have been largely futures-led, a dealer said, and a break by the Bund future above 100 could provide another boost for Guilders.
But longer term the positive outlook was still founded on fundamentals, with tight supply and cash injections from currently-sidelined investors likely to keep the market buoyant, he said.
The U.S. September CPI figures are due at 1230 GMT on Wednesday. Forecasts are for a 0.3 percent rise month on month versus a 0.1 percent rise in August.
